semanticDecisions: only the linear fallbacks change: the A7 block signals and exact masks keep the 256..32768-unit range, where cached negative blocks skip exact work

a short source is read in one window (4096 units at most), so a 16..255-unit search costs one bulk read and one intrinsic scan instead of a dispatch per unit; tuples descend once per piece instead of per unit
a unit above 0xff against Latin-1 storage answers -1 before any read, as the stock StringLatin1 search does
